**Finding submitted: missing (insurance clause absent).**

- **Investigation:** The only insurance references in the APCN 2 C&MA are cost concepts — the Capital Cost definition (p0133: "insurance of or a reasonable allowance in lieu of insurance") and Subparagraph 5.3 (p0139), which is purely permissive ("may at its own expense insure against risks"). A full-document search returned no other insurance language: no mandated coverage types, limits, additional-insured or certificate obligations. The rule therefore fails even the fallback.
- **Direction check:** The counterparty Terminal Parties act as the Maintenance Authorities and operate, maintain, deactivate and access the plant on all Parties' behalf (10.1–10.9) — the vendor-analogue exposure. Teleglobe USA is an Initial Party (p0053) but **not** a Terminal Party (p0064), so the new obligation binds only the counterparty MAs and does not weaken us.
- **Target and drafting:** Preferred level, one `insert_after` at the end of Paragraph 10 as new Subparagraph 10.10 — placed inside Paragraph 10 so the defined term "Maintenance Authority" remains valid (it is defined "for the purposes of this Paragraph 10"), avoiding a dangling term. The conditional cyber element reaches every category of data "belonging to, supplied by or processed for another Party" rather than named examples. I omitted the model language's non-element extras (at-own-expense, term-plus-one-year tail), and 5.3's permissive own-share insurance is left intact and uncontradicted.
